This plan assumes the flooded roads are unusable: Likhu temple–Jwalamukhi market, and Shivapuri farm–Suryagadhi temple. Tadi temple is not an evacuation point, so I don't drop anyone there.

- **Cut off:** Bidur farm and Trishuli farm connect only through Tarkeshwar care home, and its other road to Suryagadhi temple is buried. Those 3 adults are deferred (2×20 + 1×20 = 60).
- **Car2:** takes the 3 adults from Shivapuri farm to the hospital (22 minutes). It then makes two trips to Gosaikunda school, 4 children and then 3 children (44 minutes).
- **Car1:** takes the 2 elderly from Suryagadhi temple to the shelter (16 minutes). It then fetches the 4 children from Kalika village via Suryagadhi temple (56 minutes). Finally it brings the Dhunche school adults (10 minutes) and the Galchhi school adults (32 minutes, via Dhunche school) to the shelter.
- **Cost:** 180 minutes of driving plus 60 in penalties, so 240 in total.
